This page reports symptoms, not internal metrics: service reachability, response latency, SSL validity and measured availability. No IP addresses, logs, load, memory or disk are ever exposed here — those are internal capacity signals, kept private. Availability is honestly computed from our own probe samples (window: 30 days) and starts at 100% until the first non-operational reading. Probes run server-side against a fixed allowlist of Carbon Stealth domains and are cached for 60 seconds.
